verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents custom AI filters, written as plain-English scripts, that automatically label, star and archive email. It also offers one-click identification of important emails and todos, triggers that organize threads into todos, and importance-based Splits. Together these cover auto-labeling, categorizing, surfacing and steering. Nothing documents how a user reviews or audits what the AI did, and there is no independent hands-on evidence of AI triage accuracy. missing for 10: an audit or log of AI triage actions, hands-on corroboration of AI filter behavior, and in-depth docs on AI categorization logic.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI triages my inbox for me — auto-labeling, categorizing, and surfacing what needs attention — with behavior I can steer and audit

citations.quote: Take control of your inbox with custom AI filters. Automatically label, star, archive, and more with scripts you write in plain English.
Identify important emails & todos with a single click. Sweep away the rest.
You can define Splits based on: Importance, Built-in labels... Custom labels, Specific senders, Complex search queries
